evidence: optiland 0.6.0: set_precision is Literal['float32','float64'] and raises ValueError for anything else; set_device raises BackendCapabilityError on the numpy backend, so CUDA is reachable only through the torch backend. With set_backend('torch'); set_device('cuda'), be.array(...) returns a Tensor on cuda:0 in the selected precision, float32 and float64 both confirmed (agent_solver_gpu, RTX A6000, torch 2.13.0+cu126)
notes: There is no float16 row and this project will not invent one: Optiland has no float16 mode to execute, and geometry, OPL and direction cosines all accumulate.
